classification.difficultyReason: Choose familiar convenient x values, substitute for two points plus a check, and plot five supplied linear rules on one common coordinate system. The taught procedure is direct; the shared graph requires organisation but no unsignposted inference.

content.prompt:
On a single set of axes, draw the graphs of:

(Hint: For parts d and e, use the x-values $-2$, $0$ and $2$.)

spec.sourceRegion: Shared response grid for all five supplied lines
spec.description: A native blank square grid supplies one common drawing area. Students choose and label axes; it contains no plotted answer.
spec.mathematics: One common coordinate drawing area, as explicitly required by the source.

answer.short: $(-1,1),\ (0,0),\ (1,-1)$. Solid line on the common graph.
answer.worked: For $y=-x$, choose $x=-1, 0, 1$. Substitution gives $y=1, 0, -1$, so plot $(-1,1),\ (0,0),\ (1,-1)$. Draw the straight line through these points on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-1,-3),\ (0,0),\ (1,3)$. Dashed line on the common graph.
answer.worked: For $y=3x$, choose $x=-1, 0, 1$. Substitution gives $y=-3, 0, 3$, so plot $(-1,-3),\ (0,0),\ (1,3)$. Draw the straight line through these points on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-1,-5),\ (0,0),\ (1,5)$. Dotted line on the common graph.
answer.worked: For $y=5x$, choose $x=-1, 0, 1$. Substitution gives $y=-5, 0, 5$, so plot $(-1,-5),\ (0,0),\ (1,5)$. Draw the straight line through these points on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-2,-1),\ (0,0),\ (2,1)$. Dash-dot line on the common graph.
answer.worked: For $y=\frac12x$, choose $x=-2, 0, 2$. Substitution gives $y=-1, 0, 1$, so plot $(-2,-1),\ (0,0),\ (2,1)$. Draw the straight line through these points on the same axes as the other parts.

answer.short: $(-2,1),\ (0,0),\ (2,-1)$. Dash-dot-dot line on the common graph.
answer.worked: For $y=-\frac12x$, choose $x=-2, 0, 2$. Substitution gives $y=1, 0, -1$, so plot $(-2,1),\ (0,0),\ (2,-1)$. Draw the straight line through these points on the same axes as the other parts.

spec.description: Five whole lines on one coordinate system. The editable per-part answer names the matching line style; no legend text is embedded in the scaled graph.
